RE1MV coordinate + animation table fix report
============================================

Input tested:
  /mnt/data/EM1111(6).EMD

External reference used:
  RE1MV Delphi source from the uploaded RE1MV(2).zip.

Core fixes:
  1. RE1 TMD vertices now follow RE1MV Calculate_Pos() scaling/sign.
  2. RE1 TMD display axis is now file X,Y,Z -> display Z,Y,X.
  3. EDD/EMR animation lookup now uses the correct EMR header bytes:
       +0 PartListOffset
       +2 AnimationOffset
       +4 ObjectCount
       +6 FrameSize
  4. EDD clip table is separated into banks/clips/frames.
  5. Diagnostic viewer uses RE1MV Build_Model matrix-stack operation tables.
  6. Diagnostic BMP output flips only presentation Y so strips are not vertically mirrored.
  7. Diagnostic angle conversion matches RE1MV: (angle & 0x0FFF) / 0x0FFF * 360.

Validation:
  make clean && make: OK, no compiler warnings in final checked build log.
  bash tests/smoke.sh: OK.
  ./build/grc validate EM1111.EMD --game re1:
    verts=352 normals=900 uvs=1944 faces=648 pieces=15
    tris=648 quads=0 textured=648 invalid=0 degenerate=0 unused_vertices=0
    status=ok

Animation table summary:
  Bank A: EMR_A + EDD_A, EMD_Type=0x3C0006, poses=215, clips=12
  Bank B: EMR_B + EDD_B, EMD_Type=0x410000, poses=645, clips=31
  Example: Bank B clip 03 has 42 frames, pose range 72..113.

Strictness status:
  tools/emd_anim_table.c is static-buffer/no heap/no float/no double.
  The full public grc_model API and textured diagnostic renderer still use legacy
  float and heap allocation. This patch fixes the RE1 coordinate/animation bug and
  adds the strict animation table verifier, but it is not a complete fixed-point
  arena rewrite of the whole repository.

Generated docs/artifacts inside docs/:
  RE1MV_COORD_ANIM_FIX_NOTES.md
  RE1MV_ANIM_TABLE_EM1111.txt
  RE1MV_ANIM_TABLE_EM1111_FRAMES.txt
  EM1111_BANKB_CLIP03_FRAME_STRIP_FIXED.png
  EM1111_BANKB_CLIP03_FRAME10_FIXED.png
  EM1111_ANIM_CLIP_ATLAS_FIXED.png
